chunks.text:
Contribution and ownership
Evidence supports:

- designing fraud-monitoring KPIs for excessive sales/prescriptions and related risk patterns
- applying principal component analysis and outlier detection
- contributing unsupervised indicators for risk/behavioral monitoring
- developing supporting R tooling
- helping deliver a monitoring application for insurance-portfolio health
- translating analytical outputs into controls and client-facing reporting

The evidence supports meaningful implementation and analytical design, but not exclusive ownership of every control, case decision or downstream investigation.
